ea6b730324598f27674e82ed2b4c28e3e0b5a5a6.summary: Bitdefender reports a RIG Exploit Kit campaign that used exploits for CVE-2021-26411 in Internet Explorer to deliver RedLine Stealer, a low-cost password stealer sold on underground forums. Once run, the stealer gathers system details and exfiltrates passwords, saved cards, crypto wallets and VPN logins to a command and control server. Suggested mitigations are exploit detection in anti-virus and EDR, checking indicators of compromise, and keeping systems and third-party applications patched.

eaec34789efaff36c406a8ae812679016743e56a.summary: Cisco Talos reports a campaign active since at least December 2025 by a tracked actor, UAT-10027, delivering a previously undisclosed loader named Dohdoor. Victims are in the education and health care sectors, mainly in the United States. Initial access is likely phishing. The loader resolves C2 over DNS-over-HTTPS through Cloudflare, is sideloaded via legitimate Windows executables, performs process hollowing, and unhooks system calls to evade EDR. Talos assesses with low confidence that the actor is North Korea-nexus, based on TTP overlaps with Lazarus. Cobalt Strike use is only potential,…
